name: CE_STATEMENT_HEADERS_INT
description: CE_STATEMENT_HEADERS_INT contains information related to statement headers interface.

columns.name: STATEMENT_HEADER_INT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the bank statement header interface.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: IBAN_NUMBER
columns.description: International bank account number.

columns.name: STATEMENT_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates whether the bank statement is intra day or prior day.

columns.name: INBOUND_FILE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the inbound file.

columns.name: BANK_ACCT_USAGE
columns.description: Proprietary nature or use of the account.

columns.name: STATEMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Identification of the statement within the bank account.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Bank statement currency as reported by the bank.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM
columns.description: Bank account number to which the statement belongs.

columns.name: BANK_NAME
columns.description: Name of the bank that appears on the bank statement.

columns.name: BRANCH_NAME
columns.description: Name of the bank branch that appears on the bank statement.

columns.name: ELECTRONIC_SEQ_NUM
columns.description: Sequential number of the report, assigned by the account servicer. It is increased incrementally for each report sent electronically.

columns.name: LEGAL_SEQ_NUM
columns.description: Legal sequential number of the report, assigned by the account servicer. It is increased incrementally.

columns.name: STATEMENT_DATE
columns.description: Date when the bank statement was created. It appears on the bank statement.

columns.name: STMT_FROM_DATE
columns.description: Start date of the bank statement.

columns.name: STMT_TO_DATE
columns.description: End date of the bank statement.

columns.name: PROCESS_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Processing status of the bank statement.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
